annotations.title: Test a strategy from its headline numbers

description: For a trader with no trade list: estimates the chance of passing, the chance of a first payout and the likely fees per payout from a win rate, reward-to-risk, risk per trade and trades per day. It treats every win and every loss as the same size and every day as alike, so it is rougher than a test of real trades and usually a little optimistic.

firm.description: Or: part of a firm name, to test that firm's accounts. Leave both out to rank every account.

reward_to_risk.description: Average win divided by average loss, for example 2 for a 1:2 strategy.

risk_per_trade.description: Percentage of the account lost on a losing trade, for example 1.

trades_per_day.description: Average trades per trading day, for example 1.5.

win_rate.description: Percentage of trades that win, for example 45.

name: test_stats
title: Test a strategy from its headline numbers
